I am writing to express my extreme disappointment with the service I received at Bianca . Given that you are associated with a luxury brand, I expected a much higher level of professionalism and care, but my recent experience has been nothing short of frustrating.

I had given my son’s Raymond white suit (three pieces) for laundry on January 21st, as he needed to wear it again for his main reception on February 1st. The suit only had minor cake stains, and I assumed it would be returned in perfect condition.

To my surprise, the suit was delivered back to me on January 28th, along with a bill for all three garments. However, upon inspection, I found that some stains were still present. When I reached out to your team, they acknowledged the issue and agreed to rewash it.

•	Why was I not informed about this earlier?
•	Why was I charged for all three garments if the service was incomplete?

The only response I received was a simple “Sorry, ma’am.” I was then told that the blazer would be cleaned and delivered before January 30th. However, I later received another call stating that the blazer could not be washed due to color bleeding (black piping on the collar). This was shocking, especially since this is a Raymond suit, and I did not expect such issues.

With only a few days left before the event, I was left in a highly stressful situation. Eventually, I had to escalate the matter to Raymond, who, understanding the urgency, arranged for a brand-new blazer to be stitched within two days. However, they also informed me that if the original blazer could be washed and restored to its original condition, I would be required to pay for the extra blazer.

This entire experience has been incredibly frustrating, and I am deeply disappointed by the lack of professionalism and communication from your team. I expect a proper explanation and resolution for the inconvenience caused.
